far_git_pipeline.caveat: Pilot counts are author-reported and its corpus/output bytes are not published in the repository.
Source context is retained locally, but positional IDs, missing corpus digests, and the GapP label mismatch limit exact identity.
Find/attempt/recommend stages are distinct, but later outcomes are prose tokens rather than content-addressed Result records.
Status citations and later rechecks exist, but no public attributed status-transition history was observed.
KNOWN is a real pipeline outcome, but the Erdős 635 prior result escaped the cascade.
Stage outputs and rationales are separate, but the public artifact does not bind exact executable, formal, human, and source evidence axes.
Different model passes play roles; judge ordinals are not authenticated principals and there is no repository authority Decision.
Append-only JSONL and prose updates do not expose an attributed correction relation or deterministic state replay.
Retained local JSONL is readable, but clean Git lacks the pilot corpus, outputs, locks, workspaces, and exact provider provenance.

probxiv_public_registry.caveat: The public registry supports search and collections, not FAR's measured allocation pipeline.
Source links and an explicit formalization-fidelity caveat are strong, but no exact page/source export contract was observed.
Problem, attempt, machine judgement, formal check, and current status are visibly distinct editorial surfaces.
Current status and dates are visible and retraction is preserved; no attributed status-event history is exposed.
No duplicate state, filter, relation, or matching whole-word search result was observed.
Machine and formal checks are separately scoped and explicitly do not become proof or human review.
Tool work and account credit are separated; no attributed authority principal or Decision is exposed.
The retracted URL and attempt remain readable, but no supersession edge, attributed correction Event, or replay is exposed.
No public API, export, source repository, version, license, or reconstruction contract was observed.

vela_math_repository.caveat: Vela intentionally does not search literature, rank Problems, or allocate compute.
Exact roots and source occurrences bind scope; mathematical equivalence still requires source-owned review.
Submission, Claim, scoped Verification, Decision, Event, and derived Standing remain distinct.
Source observation time is retained outside Core; Events answer Repository admission time, not arbitrary world-valid intervals.
Exact descriptive/correction relations can retain a known-result finding, but Vela performs no novelty search.
A scoped check constrains only its declared method and never becomes acceptance by itself.
Authentication, performer, verifier, principal, signer, and authority are retained separately.
Current Math has real predecessor/successor correction Events; this does not establish the corrected science beyond its admitted scope.
Git plus the pinned signed reader reconstructs admitted state; external source pages may still disappear.

supported: Vela demonstrates an attributable Decision/Event/Standing boundary absent from the observed FAR and ProbXiv public contracts.
Vela demonstrates exact correction replay and Git-only admitted-state reconstruction on current Math records.
falsified_or_narrowed: Vela is not uniquely capable of separating attempt, machine review, formal check, and human-review limitations; ProbXiv already does this visibly.
Vela is not the better discovery or attention-allocation product; FAR is purpose-built and empirically evaluated for that job.
No evidence supports importing FAR ranking, ProbXiv editorial status, or Quipu bitemporality into Vela Core.
not_tested: Independent scientific correctness of any external candidate.
External recurrence with an independent Vela Repository authority.
Comparative throughput, research productivity, adoption, or novelty certification.
